review_kind: first static review of X0 thin output checker
status: eight findings resolved by narrow differential static review; checker not executed

findings.anchor: direct metrics indexing for full_100_prefix_200_active, fixed_upright... and windows
findings.issue: A legal source-verification or helper-import failure emits minimal metrics and explicit failure. Direct indexing raises KeyError. A later reporting failure can also leave windows unavailable.
findings.revision: Accept an explicit failed source/runtime branch with false engineering/scientific gates and independently unavailable windows. Require the complete schema only for a claimed complete engineering result. Preserve the failure and any paid budget. Do not require 300 controls or two available windows on a failed branch.

findings.issue: Integration can return and be counted before endpoint forward/diagnostics/capture fails. Confirmed paid substeps can therefore exceed saved samples on a legal partial run.
findings.revision: Require saved captures <= confirmed integrations. Bind confirmed counts to returned row executed counts or exception confirmed_completed_substeps where available. Demand equality only for a fully captured complete branch. Preserve missing-capture and effort unknown/lower-bound status.

findings.issue: A partial paid run can have a known before fingerprint and unavailable after fingerprint. This is a legitimate failed qualification, not proof that the mount changed.
findings.revision: Check equality when both fingerprints are available and require known equality for the complete engineering gate. Preserve unavailable after as unknown with qualification false.

findings.anchor: window zip iteration and MAE vector comparisons
findings.issue: zip can silently accept missing windows or short per-axis MAE vectors.
findings.revision: For an available window require exactly two axis MAEs, finite values, the frozen 20 endpoint indices, target binding and .01 threshold. For a full result require exactly the two frozen windows. Reporting failures may expose each window independently as unavailable, forcing the gate false.

findings.issue: The number of available and actually recalculated windows is independent of overall completion. A structurally complete trajectory can have a reporting failure in one window, and a partial trajectory may contain one usable window.
findings.revision: Count two new MAE recalculations per independently available window actually computed by the checker. Preserve unavailable-window reasons; do not recompute old scientific gates.

findings.issue: The new c4_contact_scientific_validation flag is omitted from the always-false contract.
findings.revision: Include c4_contact_scientific_validation among the frozen false flags. An X0 engineering result cannot release old C4 contact science or C5.

findings.issue: Checking only the category enum does not bind left_arm/feet/other classification to recorded public geometry names.
findings.revision: Check the frozen public name-based classification without using contact data as a pass condition or interpreting it causally.

findings.anchor: native_complete and separate contact finite check
findings.issue: Producer complete telemetry includes finite contact diagnostics. Checker native_complete currently excludes that component.
findings.revision: Align complete finite telemetry with the producer definition. A missing/nonfinite contact diagnostic invalidates a complete-telemetry claim while preserving paid partial records and explicit unknowns.

approved_elements: Only the new engineering MAEs and new engineering gate are recomputed.
Target errors are bound to saved native after-state and target.
Complete control has priority over an error ranking or stop-free count.
science_boundary: This static review verifies output-contract handling only. It performs no new physics, reads no formal X0 outputs, changes no scientific gate and does not establish engineering or scientific success.

differential_followup.additional_dependency_checks: Two narrow rg reads of frozen producer and public geometry source; returned snippets only. Backend total IO is unknown.

resolved_findings.result: Minimal failed source/helper/reporting branches retain explicit failure, false gate and missing-window handling.
Confirmed returned and exceptional row substeps are accumulated; captures are a lower bound on paid integrations.
Unknown before/after fingerprint is legal only with an explicit failed run; known fingerprints must agree.
A complete claim requires two frozen windows, each with two finite MAEs, 20 saved endpoints, native target-error binding and the original threshold.
New MAE accounting is two per actually available window; availability is separately calculated within the frozen full-trial requirement.
c4_contact_scientific_validation is checked false alongside the other frozen scientific flags.
Classification matches the frozen public left-arm and foot geometry names, with floor binding and finite contact telemetry.
Finite contact diagnostics contribute to complete native telemetry.

differential_followup.availability_clarification: The first review's suggestion that a partial trial could expose a qualifying usable window is superseded: frozen producer full_trial_required=true means no partial-trial window is available. Independence means each window also needs its own 20 finite errors, and each missing reporting window retains its own unavailable status. No full-trial gate is relaxed.
differential_followup.engineering_gate_preserved: qualified requires full finite 300/3000 telemetry, fixed mount, exactly two passing original windows and no explicit failure.
